messages.content: I'm done. Three years of 'wealth management' and my portfolio XIRR is 6.2%. A Nifty index fund did 13% in the same period. I paid you 1% advisory fee every year to underperform a free index? Send me the account closure process.

Hi Aditya, thank you for the direct feedback, and the numbers you've quoted are accurate. Your portfolio was positioned conservatively after the risk assessment in 2023 flagged you as moderate-risk, which capped equity at 50%. That positioning cost returns in a bull market, and the fee on top made it worse.

I told your advisor in 2024 itself to increase my equity and he said 'stay the course'. Staying the course cost me around ₹4 lakh in missed gains by my calculation. Why should I pay for advice that ignores what I ask?

That 2024 conversation should have triggered a risk profile review, and it didn't — that's a genuine service failure. Before you close the account, here's what I can offer: advisory fee waived for the next 12 months, an immediate reallocation to your desired equity level, and a switch to our performance-linked fee plan where we only charge if we beat the index. If we still underperform, you lose nothing more by leaving then.
Performance-linked fee is the only honest model anyway. Alright, I'll give it one year, but I want the reallocation done this week and the 2024 review failure formally acknowledged.

Agreed on all three. The reallocation instructions are being placed today, the fee waiver and new plan are active from this billing cycle, and you'll receive a written acknowledgement of the 2024 service lapse within 2 working days. I appreciate you giving us the year, Aditya.

labels.reason: Customer requested account closure after 3 years of 6.2% XIRR versus 13% index returns while paying 1% advisory fee
Advisor ignored the customer's 2024 request to increase equity allocation without a risk profile review

messages.content: I applied for premature closure of my FD 9 days back because I need money for my mother's surgery. Your app says 'processing', branch says 'apply online', online support says 'visit branch'. My mother's operation is on Friday. What do I do, beg?

Ritu, I'm so sorry, both for the situation with your mother and for how we've handled this. No one should be passed around like that for their own money. Give me a moment to check the FD closure request... I see it stuck at a manual verification step that was never assigned to anyone.
Never assigned?! For 9 days?! It's ₹4.5 lakh and I need it in my account before Friday or I'll have to take an emergency loan at some crazy interest because of YOUR mistake.

You will not need to take a loan. I've escalated this to the operations head with a medical emergency flag — the verification is being completed right now while we chat. The FD closure will be processed today and ₹4.5 lakh plus accrued interest will credit to your account by tomorrow morning, well before Friday.
I'll believe it when I see the money. Honestly after this, once the surgery is done I'm moving my salary account and everything else out of this bank.

I understand, and right now the priority is your mother's surgery. The credit confirmation will be SMS'd to you tonight, and I've logged complaint reference CMP20260810934 for the unassigned request so it's formally investigated. Wishing your mother a smooth surgery and recovery.

labels.reason: FD premature closure for a medical emergency stuck unassigned for 9 days with customer bounced between channels
Customer stated she will move her salary account and all holdings out of the bank after the surgery

messages.content: Hi, I just got an SMS saying 'New login to your account from Chrome on Windows, Mumbai' at 2:14 AM. I was sleeping and I only ever use the app on my phone in Nagpur. Someone is inside my account!

Sameer, thank you for flagging this immediately. I'm putting a temporary security hold on your account right now so no transactions or changes can be made... Done. I can see the Mumbai login on our end. Have you shared your password or OTP with anyone recently, even accidentally?
No, never. But I use the same password for many websites, honestly. Has anything been taken? I have ₹2.7 lakh in liquid funds there.

Checking your activity log... No redemptions, no bank account changes, no new mandates. The session only viewed your portfolio before our system flagged it. Reusing passwords is likely how they got in — if any other site was breached, attackers try the same credentials here. I've terminated all active sessions and logged out every device.
Thank god nothing is gone. What should I do now to make sure this doesn't happen again?

Three things: I'm sending a password reset link to your registered mobile, please set a unique password you use nowhere else. Second, I've made two-factor authentication mandatory on your account, so every login now needs an OTP. Third, I've filed security incident SEC20260810644 and our fraud team will watch your account for 30 days. You'll get an SMS for any login attempt going forward.

labels.reason: Unauthorized login from an unrecognised device and city, likely via credential reuse, caught before any funds were moved

messages.content: Please help urgently. My phone had no network since morning, and when I got it working with a new SIM, I saw messages that ₹95,000 was transferred from my account through UPI in 3 transactions last night. I did NOT do any of these!

Bhavna, no network all morning followed by transfers you didn't make — this is the classic pattern of SIM swap fraud. Someone likely got a duplicate SIM issued in your name, received your OTPs, and made the transfers while your phone was dead. I'm blocking your UPI handle and freezing your account immediately... Done. Can you confirm the last transaction you made yourself?

Last one by me was ₹1,200 to the grocery shop on Saturday morning. These three transfers of ₹40,000, ₹40,000 and ₹15,000 to some 'Rakesh Enterprises' are not mine. Can I get my money back? That's my son's school fees.

I've raised a fraud dispute for all three transactions totalling ₹95,000 with reference FRD20260810388, and flagged the beneficiary account to the receiving bank for a freeze. Since you're reporting within 24 hours of the debits, RBI's zero-liability protection applies for unauthorized electronic transactions. Please also do two things: file a complaint on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930 right away — the golden hour matters for freezing the money — and ask your telecom operator how the duplicate SIM was issued.
Calling 1930 right now. How long for the provisional credit? And is my account safe to use after this?

Provisional credit of ₹95,000 will reflect within 10 working days as per RBI norms, and I'll message you as soon as the receiving bank confirms the freeze. Your account stays frozen until your new SIM is verified — once you share the cybercrime acknowledgement number, we'll re-enable it with a new UPI PIN, fresh device binding, and a daily transfer limit you can set yourself.

labels.reason: SIM swap attack led to three unauthorized UPI transfers totalling ₹95,000, reported within 24 hours

messages.content: Sir, yesterday my mutual fund app was showing error so I searched customer care number on Google and called. The person asked me to install AnyDesk app to 'fix' the problem. Today ₹78,000 has been redeemed from my fund and sent to some account. I never approved this!

Prakash ji, I'm sorry to tell you that number was not ours — fraudsters post fake helpline numbers on Google, and AnyDesk gave them full remote control of your phone, including your app and OTPs. First, please uninstall AnyDesk right now. I'm blocking your account and all pending transactions immediately... Done. The ₹78,000 redemption shows as processed with payout to a bank account added yesterday.
Uninstalled it. I feel so stupid, he sounded exactly like a real support person, even told me my name and folio number. Can the payout be stopped? It's from my emergency fund.

Don't blame yourself — these scammers are professionals and this exact fraud is very common. Good news: the payout is still in T+1 settlement and hasn't left for the beneficiary bank yet. I've placed an emergency stop on it and reversed the redemption request. Your units will be restored within 2 working days. I've also removed the fraudulent bank account they added and filed incident FRD20260810725.
Oh thank god, thank you! What about my phone? He had full control, what else can he see?

Treat the phone as compromised: change your app PIN and password from a different device first, then change your email and banking passwords, and run a factory reset if possible. Never install screen-sharing apps for any 'support' call — we will never ask for that. Our real helpline is only the number printed in the app under Help. I've enforced a 48-hour cooling period on your account for any new bank account additions, and our fraud team will call you tomorrow to confirm everything is secure.

labels.reason: Fake customer care number and AnyDesk remote access scam led to an unauthorized ₹78,000 redemption, stopped before settlement

messages.content: Hi, I want to change the email ID on my account from my old Yahoo to my Gmail. What's the process?
Hi Ishita! Simple one — in the app go to Profile, then Contact Details, edit the email and confirm with the OTP that comes to your registered mobile. Two minutes. Anything else while I'm here?

Doing it now. Btw slightly random, but for the past 2-3 days I keep getting OTP SMSes from you at odd hours, like 1 or 2 AM, when I'm not even using the app. Yesterday there were four or five. I've just been ignoring them, it's some glitch I guess?

I'm glad you mentioned this — that's usually not a glitch. OTPs are generated only when someone enters your number or email on a login or reset screen. Once could be a stranger's typo, but repeated attempts at 1-2 AM suggests someone may be trying to get into your account. Please change your password right now from inside the app, and enable fingerprint login while you're in Settings. I'm also flagging your account for a security review of where those OTP requests came from.
Oh no, I genuinely thought it was an app bug. Okay, password changed and fingerprint is on. Email update is also done.

Perfect, the Gmail ID is verified and active. Our security team will trace the OTP request sources and message you if anything more is needed — and if the odd-hour OTPs continue even after the password change, tell us immediately.

labels.reason: Repeated late-night unrequested OTPs disclosed only in passing during a routine email change — likely ongoing access attempts the customer had been dismissing as a glitch, the kind of buried mention that goes unflagged

messages.content: I'm checking my trading account statement and there are 4 intraday trades in penny stocks on 6th August that I never placed. I only do delivery buying of large caps, maybe once a month. Total loss from these trades is ₹31,400. Who traded in MY account?

Yusuf, unauthorized trades are a serious matter and I'm treating this on priority. I've suspended trading on your account right now and force-logged-out all sessions. I can see the 4 trades were placed via API access from a third-party terminal, not from our app. Did you ever generate an API key or link your account to any algo trading or 'guaranteed returns' platform?

API key? Wait... 2 months back I joined a Telegram group that promised stock tips, and their 'account manager' walked me through some setup on the website to 'sync recommendations'. Is that what this is?

Yes — that setup generated an API key that gave the Telegram operators direct trading access to your account. These groups run pump-and-dump schemes using victims' accounts to inflate penny stocks. I've revoked the API key permanently and preserved the trade logs. I'm filing this as unauthorized access, reference FRD20260810856, and you should also report the Telegram group to SEBI's SCORES portal — I'll send you the link and a pre-filled summary of the trades.
Please do. What about my ₹31,400? And when can I trade normally again?

Since the trades came through an API key generated with your credentials, the recovery route is the SEBI complaint and police cybercrime report — I'll support both with complete evidence: IP logs, timestamps, and order trails. Meanwhile, your account is being reactivated with API access disabled, a new password, and mandatory OTP for every order placed outside our official app. Our fraud team will also review whether the counterparty accounts in those trades can be traced — some victims do recover funds when SEBI freezes the operators' accounts.

labels.reason: Telegram stock-tip scam obtained API access and placed 4 unauthorized penny stock trades causing ₹31,400 loss

messages.content: Hi, my CA is asking for capital gains statement for FY 2025-26 for ITR filing. Where do I find it in the app?

Sure, send it. No hurry, I'll look at it after filing this year's return.

Arnav, I understand the urgency and I'm sorry for the stress. Let me trace it... The redemption was processed by the AMC on time, but the payout failed and the credit was returned to the AMC yesterday.

Verified — your new IFSC just passed the penny-drop check. I've raised the urgent reprocessing with reference RD20260810668 and will message you the moment the AMC confirms the payout. You won't need to follow up.

Hi Ritika! Go to Portfolio > three-dot menu > Export Holdings, and choose Excel. It includes fund names, units, purchase dates, invested value and current value. Anything specific you're trying to work out? Happy to help.

messages.content: I just got an SMS that a UPI autopay mandate of ₹15,000 per month was set up on my account for 'QuickGamingPro'. I never did this! I don't even play games!

Sanjay, thank you for flagging this immediately. I can see the mandate was created 20 minutes ago via UPI. I'm suspending it right now so no money can be debited... Done, the mandate is blocked. Has any amount actually been debited yet?
No debit yet, balance is same. But how did this even happen? I didn't approve anything on my UPI app. My phone was with my nephew for an hour today though, he plays games on it.

That's very likely the source — mandate approvals only need the UPI PIN on the device, and kids often approve prompts inside game apps without realising. Since no money moved, there's no loss. I've cancelled the mandate permanently and I recommend changing your UPI PIN today and enabling app lock on your UPI app. Also check the game's account settings on the phone for stored payment methods.
Oh god, it must be him. Changing the PIN now. Thank you for blocking it so fast!
Glad we caught it before any debit, Sanjay. I've noted the incident on your account with reference UPI20260810554. If you see any suspicious SMS again, reach out immediately.

labels.reason: Unauthorized UPI autopay mandate blocked before any debit, likely caused by family member on customer's device rather than external fraud

messages.content: Quick question, what does XIRR mean in my portfolio? It shows 14.2% but my absolute return shows 31%. Which one is real?

Good question, Varun! Both are real, they measure differently. Absolute return is total growth since you invested (31% over your ~2.5 years). XIRR is the annualised rate accounting for the timing of every SIP instalment — 14.2% per year in your case, which is the better number for comparing against FDs or other investments.
Ah makes sense, so 14.2% yearly. That's way better than my FD giving 7%. Maybe I should move some FD money here too, but let me think about it.

It has been a strong period for equity, though do keep in mind markets fluctuate year to year unlike FDs. If you ever want, we can look at your FD maturity dates and plan a staggered move that matches your risk comfort. No pressure, just say the word!
Cool, will ping you when my FD matures in November. Thanks for explaining!

labels.reason: Customer casually mentioned possibly moving FD money after understanding returns, deferred to November with no commitment

messages.content: I just saw an email that your advisory fee is increasing from 0.5% to 0.75% from October. That's a 50% hike! Nobody asked us. How do I close my account and move out?

Hi Shalini, I understand the frustration — a fee change affects returns directly and the communication should have been clearer. Before you decide, may I share what's changing? The new fee includes quarterly rebalancing calls and tax-loss harvesting, which on a ₹15 lakh portfolio like yours typically saves more than the 0.25% difference.
That's what every company says when they raise prices. I did the math, 0.25% extra on ₹15 lakh is ₹3,750 a year. Direct funds on Kuvera cost me zero. Give me one real reason to stay.

Fair challenge. Honestly, if you're comfortable choosing and rebalancing funds yourself, direct plans are cheaper and I won't pretend otherwise. What we add is discipline and tax optimisation — last year our harvesting saved you ₹6,200 in LTCG tax, which is in your March report. Alternatively, I can grandfather you at 0.5% for 12 more months as a long-time customer. Would that work?
Hmm. Keep me at 0.5% for the year and I'll stay for now. But I'm watching, if service drops I'm gone.
Locked in — 0.5% until October 2027, confirmation email on its way. And noted seriously on the service expectation, Shalini. Thank you for being direct with us.

labels.reason: Customer threatened account closure over 50% advisory fee hike, retained only via a 12-month fee grandfather

messages.content: Hi, my father is 58 and retiring in 2 years. Is it too late for him to get term insurance? Roughly what would premium be?

Hi Rajesh! Not too late, though premiums at 58 are steep — a ₹50 lakh cover for 10 years would run roughly ₹55,000-70,000 per year depending on his health. May I ask what you're trying to protect against? For retirees, sometimes health insurance or an annuity fits the actual need better than term cover.
Main worry is his pending home loan of ₹18 lakh. If something happens to him, mom shouldn't have that burden.

That clarifies it — for loan protection specifically, a decreasing-cover term plan matched to the loan schedule is much cheaper, roughly ₹25,000-30,000 per year for ₹18 lakh reducing cover. Some lenders also offer loan insurance directly. If you share his loan tenure and lender, I can get exact quotes from 3 insurers.
It's with LIC Housing Finance, 8 years left. Send me the quotes, I'll discuss with dad this weekend.

labels.reason: Genuine insurance need for father's loan protection with quotes requested, but decision pending family discussion
